newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Comms seeks more attractive Liberty stock.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Comms seeks more attractive Liberty stock.

text.p: A stock dividend for holders of Liberty Media Group shares was aimed at finding a more attractive price for the stock, a spokeswoman said on Monday.

Late Friday, Tele-Communications Inc said it would pay a stock dividend to holders of its Liberty Media unit of one share of Liberty Media for every two shares of Liberty Media Group Series A or Series B stock held.

The move creates more shares and thus can be expected to lower the stock price. The spokeswoman said stocks trading in a range of $15 to $25 per share tend to more attractive to investors. On Monday Liberty shares rose 1/8 to 27-7/8.
The shares will be distributed on Jan. 13.
